text.en: A letter from the benefits office offers two options: claim early for a smaller payment, or wait for a bigger one. It's 14 pages long, and the fine print has its own fine print.
text.zh: 退休金辦公室來信提供兩個選項：提早領取但金額較少，或是等待領更多。信有 14 頁，小字裡還有小字。

text.en: Claim early. Enjoy the money now.
text.zh: 提早領。現在就享受這筆錢。

text.en: Keep working and claim later for the bigger payment. Future You sends a thank-you note.
text.zh: 繼續工作，晚點再領更大筆的。未來的你會寄來一張感謝卡。

text.en: Your doctor recommends a routine screening for people your age. The prep involves a special drink that tastes like regret and an evening spent near the bathroom.
text.zh: 醫生建議你這個年紀該做例行檢查。準備工作包括喝一種嚐起來像後悔的特調飲料，以及整晚守在廁所旁。

text.en: Do it. Drink the regret. Be a grown-up about it.
text.zh: 去做。喝下那杯後悔。當個成熟的大人。

text.en: Postpone it 'until things calm down'. Things never calm down.
text.zh: 拖到『等事情平靜下來再說』。事情永遠不會平靜。

text.en: You join a pottery class. The instructor is 23, calls you 'a natural', and your first bowl looks like a hat.
text.zh: 你報名了陶藝課。老師才 23 歲，說你『很有天分』，而你的第一個碗看起來像一頂帽子。

text.en: Keep going. Gift the 'hat bowl' to everyone you know.
text.zh: 繼續上課。把『帽子碗』送給你認識的每個人。

text.en: Quit after one lesson and blame the clay.
text.zh: 上完一堂就放棄，怪罪黏土。

text.en: Your high-school sweetheart finds you online: 'Coffee? I promise to be less dramatic than at seventeen.'
text.zh: 你的高中初戀在網路上找到你：『喝杯咖啡？我保證比十七歲時低調一點。』

text.en: Meet for coffee. Bring spare reading glasses and your best posture.
text.zh: 去喝咖啡。帶上備用老花眼鏡，挺直腰桿。

text.en: Send a warm reply and keep the memories in their box.
text.zh: 回一則溫暖的訊息，把回憶留在盒子裡。

text.en: Your smart home has developed opinions. The thermostat judges you, the fridge locks itself at midnight, and the doorbell keeps saying 'you again?'
text.zh: 你的智慧家居開始有自己的意見。恆溫器在批評你，冰箱午夜自動上鎖，門鈴一直說『又是你？』

text.en: Learn the settings. Become the bossiest person in the house.
text.zh: 研究設定，成為家裡最霸道的人。

text.en: Rip it all out and go analog. A light switch never talks back.
text.zh: 全部拆掉，回歸類比。電燈開關絕不會回嘴。

text.en: Your 30-something kid moves back home 'temporarily' with a rescue dog, three plants, and a startup idea about subscription toothpicks.
text.zh: 你三十多歲的孩子『暫時』搬回家，帶著一隻收容所的狗、三盆植物，和一個訂閱制牙籤的創業點子。

text.en: Let them stay. Post house rules on a laminated card.
text.zh: 讓他們住下。把家規護貝貼在牆上。

text.en: Set a move-out date. Be the loving landlord nobody asked for.
text.zh: 訂下搬出日期。當個沒人要求的慈愛房東。

text.en: A friend dares you to sign up for a half-marathon. Your knees demand to speak to a manager.
text.zh: 朋友激你報名半程馬拉松。你的膝蓋要求見經理。

text.en: Train for it. Finish last, wearing your medal like a hero.
text.zh: 認真訓練。最後一名衝線，把獎牌戴得像英雄。

text.en: Volunteer at the water station. Cheering counts as cardio.
text.zh: 去水站當志工。加油吶喊也算有氧。

text.en: You learn a foreign language for a dream trip. After three months, you can order soup and apologize. That's it.
text.zh: 你為了夢想旅程學一門外語。三個月後，你會點湯，也會道歉。就這樣。

text.en: Go anyway. Order soup with confidence and apologize to everyone.
text.zh: 照樣出發。自信地點湯，並向每個人道歉。

text.en: Stay home and cook the soup yourself. The trip lives in your imagination.
text.zh: 留在家自己煮湯。旅行活在你的想像裡。

text.en: You've said 'what?' so often that your family made it your nickname. A hearing test suggests a tiny device with big opinions.
text.zh: 你太常說『什麼？』，家人乾脆把它當成你的綽號。聽力檢查建議你戴一個意見很多的小裝置。

text.en: Get hearing aids. Discover the family group chat was never that quiet.
text.zh: 配助聽器。發現家人群組原來從來沒那麼安靜。

text.en: Keep nodding and smiling. Accidentally agree to host the next holiday.
text.zh: 繼續點頭微笑。結果不小心答應主辦下一次節日聚會。

text.en: A travel agent offers a 'once-in-a-lifetime' 40-day cruise. The brochure has one photo of a buffet and three of a life jacket.
text.zh: 旅行社推銷『一生一次』的 40 天郵輪。手冊裡有一張自助餐照片，和三張救生衣照片。

text.en: Book it. Pack sea-sickness pills and pure optimism.
text.zh: 訂了。帶上暈船藥和滿滿的樂觀。

text.en: Take a week-long scenic train ride instead. Views without sea legs.
text.zh: 改搭一週的景觀火車。有風景，不用海上腳。

text.en: Your book club has split into two factions over whether the last novel's ending was 'brilliant' or 'a crime'. Snacks are being weaponized.
text.zh: 你的讀書會為了上一本小說的結局是『天才之作』還是『犯罪』分裂成兩派。點心正被當成武器。

text.en: Start your own club with better snacks.
text.zh: 自己另開一個讀書會，點心更好。

text.en: Play peacemaker: propose a book nobody has read yet.
text.zh: 當和事佬：提議讀一本沒人看過的書。

text.en: Your tomatoes are outperforming your neighbor's. He has started leaving anonymous notes: 'Nice tomatoes. Shame if something happened to them.'
text.zh: 你的番茄長得比鄰居的好。他開始留匿名紙條：『番茄不錯。要是出了什麼事就可惜了。』

text.en: Escalate: install a tiny fence and a very small security camera.
text.zh: 升級戰局：架一道小圍籬，再裝一台迷你監視器。

text.en: Deliver a basket of tomatoes. Defeat him with kindness.
text.zh: 送一籃番茄過去。用善意擊敗他。

text.en: A letter from the government congratulates you on nearly reaching 100. Enclosed is a form asking you to confirm you're still alive.
text.zh: 政府來信恭喜你即將滿一百歲。信裡附了一張表格，要你確認自己還活著。

text.en: Frame the letter and mail back the form with a smiley face.
text.zh: 把信裱框，並在表格上畫個笑臉寄回去。

text.en: Ignore it and nap. Officially, you're 'under review'.
text.zh: 不理它，去睡午覺。官方紀錄上，你『審核中』。

text.en: Your birthday cake has so many candles that the fire department sends a polite email.
text.zh: 你的生日蛋糕蠟燭多到消防局寄來一封禮貌的電子郵件。

text.en: Blow them out with the whole family. It's a team sport.
text.zh: 全家人一起吹。這是團體運動。

text.en: Use one candle shaped like your age. Efficiency is wisdom.
text.zh: 只插一根數字形狀的蠟燭。效率就是智慧。

text.en: Your great-grandchild needs to interview you for a school project: 'What was it like before the internet?'
text.zh: 你的曾孫要為學校作業訪問你：『網路出現以前是什麼樣子？』

text.en: Tell the whole story, embellished with a few dinosaurs.
text.zh: 把整段故事講完，還加了幾隻恐龍。

text.en: Hand over a box of old photos and take a nap.
text.zh: 交出一盒老照片，然後去睡午覺。

text.en: Your family sets up a video call with fourteen relatives. Nobody is muted, and someone's parrot is singing.
text.zh: 家人幫你開了一場十四位親戚的視訊通話。沒有人關麥克風，還有人的鸚鵡在唱歌。

text.en: Stay on and become the star of the chaos.
text.zh: 留在線上，成為這場混亂的主角。

text.en: Say the screen froze and take a nap.
text.zh: 說畫面卡住了，然後去睡午覺。

text.en: Your family begs for your legendary recipe. You've kept it secret for seventy years.
text.zh: 家人苦苦哀求你傳授那道傳說中的食譜。你已經保密七十年了。

text.en: Write it down. Change one ingredient to keep them guessing.
text.zh: 寫下來，但偷偷改掉一樣材料，讓他們繼續猜。

text.en: Keep it secret. The mystery is the seasoning.
text.zh: 繼續保密。神祕感就是最好的調味料。

text.en: The town asks you to seal a time capsule to be opened in fifty years. You're the guest of honor. Everyone is politely doing the math.
text.zh: 小鎮請你為一個五十年後才開啟的時光膠囊封口。你是貴賓，每個人都在禮貌地心算。

text.en: Add a letter and your favorite hat. Plan to attend the opening.
text.zh: 放進一封信和你最愛的帽子。計劃出席開啟儀式。

text.en: Add one note: 'Buy low, sell high.' Nothing else.
text.zh: 只放一張字條：『低買高賣。』沒別的了。

text.en: The park names a bench after you for 'outstanding longevity'. It is deeply uncomfortable.
text.zh: 公園以『傑出長壽』為由，用你的名字命名了一張長椅。它坐起來非常不舒服。

text.en: Sit on it daily and greet every stranger.
text.zh: 每天坐在上面，向每個路人打招呼。

text.en: Demand a cushion. Longevity should come with back support.
text.zh: 要求加個坐墊。長壽應該附贈腰部支撐。

text.en: You realize you've outlived your entire 'someday' list. You start a new one titled 'Tomorrow, Maybe'.
text.zh: 你發現自己已經活得比整份『有一天』清單還久。於是你開了一份新的，標題是『明天，也許』。

text.en: Tackle it: ice cream for breakfast, a sunrise, and a handwritten note to an old friend.
text.zh: 一項項完成：早餐吃冰淇淋、看日出、寫一封手寫信給老朋友。

text.en: Nap first. The list has waited this long.
text.zh: 先睡一覺。清單都等這麼久了。

text.en: A local paper asks you to write a weekly advice column. Your first tip: 'Drink water and be kind. Everything else is decoration.'
text.zh: 地方報社邀你寫每週的建議專欄。你的第一則建議：『多喝水，對人好。其他都是裝飾。』

text.en: Accept. Become the town oracle.
text.zh: 接下專欄，成為小鎮的先知。

text.en: Decline politely. Wisdom is free at the kitchen table.
text.zh: 禮貌婉拒。智慧在廚房餐桌上就是免費的。

text.en: You've outlived most of your old friends. The neighborhood kids invite you to their game night.
text.zh: 你的老朋友大多已經先走一步。附近的孩子邀你參加他們的遊戲之夜。

text.en: Join. Learn a card game whose rules were invented by a nine-year-old.
text.zh: 加入。學一種規則由九歲小孩發明的紙牌遊戲。

text.en: Stay in with tea and your old records.
text.zh: 留在家，泡杯茶聽老唱片。

text.en: You slip in the garden. The paramedic calls you 'the toughest person I've met today'.
text.zh: 你在花園滑了一跤。救護員說你是『我今天遇過最硬的人』。

text.en: Go to the clinic for a checkup and accept a sturdy cane.
text.zh: 去診所做檢查，並接受一根堅固的手杖。

text.en: Insist on ice cream first, then the checkup.
text.zh: 堅持先吃冰淇淋，再做檢查。

text.en: Every online form's birth-year menu starts too late for you.
text.zh: 每一份線上表格的出生年份選單，起點都晚得沒你的份。

text.en: Ask the grandkids to fill it in. Delegation is wisdom.
text.zh: 請孫子代填。懂得授權就是智慧。

text.en: Write a strongly worded letter to the website. On paper.
text.zh: 寫一封措辭強烈的信給網站。用紙寫的。

text.en: A squirrel has decided you're its personal secretary. It leaves acorns on your windowsill with 'urgent' notes.
text.zh: 一隻松鼠認定你是牠的私人祕書。牠在你的窗台留下橡實和『緊急』紙條。

text.en: Accept the job. Answer the acorn mail.
text.zh: 接下這份工作，回覆橡實信件。

text.en: Resign politely. The squirrel goes on strike outside.
text.zh: 禮貌請辭。松鼠在窗外罷工。

text.en: Your favorite armchair has been replaced by a modern recliner with fourteen buttons. It talks.
text.zh: 你最愛的扶手椅被換成一張有十四個按鈕的新款躺椅。它會說話。

text.en: Learn all fourteen buttons. Become master of the chair.
text.zh: 學會全部十四個按鈕，成為椅子的主人。

text.en: Keep the old chair. It remembers your shape.
text.zh: 留下舊椅子。它記得你的形狀。

text.en: The care-home band asks what song you'd like. You say: 'the one from my wedding.' Nobody knows it, but everyone hums along.
text.zh: 安養院的樂團問你想聽什麼歌。你說：『我婚禮上的那首。』沒人聽過，但大家都跟著哼。

text.en: Sing it yourself. Every wrong note is a memory.
text.zh: 自己唱。每一個走音都是一段回憶。

text.en: Hum along and let the band figure it out.
text.zh: 跟著哼，讓樂團自己摸索。

text.en: Everyone expects you to go straight to college. You want a gap year 'to find yourself'. Your savings: $412 and a very confident backpack.
text.zh: 所有人都期待你直接上大學。你想休一年『間隔年』找自己。你的存款：412 美金，加上一個信心滿滿的背包。

text.en: Enroll in college. Find yourself in the cafeteria line.
text.zh: 去念大學。在餐廳排隊的隊伍裡找自己。

text.en: Take the gap year. Find yourself, hopefully near a beach.
text.zh: 休間隔年。希望能在海灘附近找到自己。

text.en: Your assigned dorm roommate collects taxidermy squirrels and has strong opinions about your sleep schedule.
text.zh: 系統分配給你的宿舍室友蒐集松鼠標本，而且對你的作息有強烈意見。

text.en: Stay. Negotiate a 'no squirrels after 10 p.m.' treaty.
text.zh: 留下來。談判出一份『晚上十點後不准出現松鼠』的條約。

text.en: Pay extra for a single room. Peace has a price tag.
text.zh: 加錢換單人房。平靜是有標價的。

text.en: You fail your driving test for the second time. The examiner writes 'confident, but wrong' on your report.
text.zh: 你的駕照考試第二次不及格。考官在報告上寫著：『很有自信，但是錯的。』

text.en: Book a third test and take lessons from your grandma.
text.zh: 報名第三次考試，並向奶奶學開車。

text.en: Go carless. Bike everywhere and call it 'sustainable'.
text.zh: 放棄開車。騎腳踏車到處跑，還美其名為『永續生活』。

text.en: A campus table offers a free T-shirt if you sign up for a credit card. The shirt is remarkably soft.
text.zh: 校園攤位說，辦一張信用卡就送免費 T 恤。那件 T 恤質地舒服得不可思議。

text.en: Sign up. Softness has no price (until the statement arrives).
text.zh: 辦卡。柔軟無價（直到帳單寄來為止）。

text.en: Walk away. Your neck stays in the freezing weather.
text.zh: 轉身離開。你的脖子繼續暴露在寒風裡。

text.en: Summer job options: lifeguard at a pool with a suspicious smell, or a giant mascot suit at a burger stand in July.
text.zh: 暑期工作二選一：在氣味可疑的游泳池當救生員，或是在七月穿巨型吉祥物裝在漢堡攤前發傳單。

text.en: Wear the mascot suit. Sweat is a form of branding.
text.zh: 穿上吉祥物裝。汗水也是一種品牌經營。

text.en: Guard the pool. Nobody drowns, everybody sighs.
text.zh: 守護泳池。沒有人溺水，只有人嘆氣。

text.en: Your parents set a midnight curfew for a legal adult. Their leverage: free laundry and pasta.
text.zh: 你的父母替一個法定成年人訂了午夜門禁。他們的籌碼：免費洗衣服，以及義大利麵。

text.en: Follow it. Enjoy the pasta and fold your dignity neatly.
text.zh: 乖乖遵守。享用義大利麵，並把尊嚴摺得整整齊齊。

text.en: Move into a shared flat above a noisy bakery.
text.zh: 搬進一間在吵鬧麵包店樓上的合租公寓。

text.en: Your first election: the ballot has 43 items, and you've read none of them. A stranger offers a 'cheat sheet'.
text.zh: 你的第一次投票：選票上有 43 個項目，你一個都沒讀過。一位陌生人遞來『小抄』。

text.en: Read every item. Arrive late, but informed.
text.zh: 把每個項目都讀完。遲到，但很有見識。

text.en: Decide the first three and skip the rest. Democracy is a marathon.
text.zh: 只決定前三項，其餘跳過。民主是場馬拉松。

text.en: You want a tattoo of your crush's name. You've known them for eleven days.
text.zh: 你想刺一個暗戀對象名字的刺青。你認識對方十一天了。

text.en: Get it. Commitment looks great on skin.
text.zh: 刺下去。承諾在皮膚上看起來很棒。

text.en: Get a tiny cactus instead. Prickly and low-maintenance.
text.zh: 改刺一株小仙人掌。帶刺而且好照顧。

text.en: The valedictorian loses their voice. You're asked to give the graduation speech: five minutes, three index cards.
text.zh: 畢業生代表突然失聲，你被臨時拉去致詞：五分鐘、三張小卡片。

text.en: Wing it with jokes about the cafeteria.
text.zh: 隨興發揮，全是關於學校餐廳的笑話。

text.en: Read the cards. They are somehow in the wrong order.
text.zh: 照著卡片念。卡片不知為何順序全亂了。

text.en: The required textbook costs $280. It's a 'new edition' with two changed commas.
text.zh: 指定教科書要價 280 美金。所謂『新版』只改了兩個逗號。

text.en: Buy it new. Enjoy the smell of overpriced paper.
text.zh: 買全新的。聞著昂貴紙張的味道。

text.en: Share one copy with three strangers via a 'study group'.
text.zh: 跟三個陌生人組成『讀書會』共用一本。

text.en: Your final essay is due at 9 a.m. It's 1 a.m. You have a title and a mug.
text.zh: 期末報告早上九點截止。現在凌晨一點。你只有一個標題和一個馬克杯。

text.en: Pull an all-nighter. Coffee is a food group.
text.zh: 熬夜趕工。咖啡也算一種食物類別。

text.en: Email the professor for an extension. Include three apologies.
text.zh: 寫信向教授要求延期。附上三次道歉。

text.en: The club fair has 200 booths. One promises free snacks; another promises 'life-changing networking'.
text.zh: 社團博覽會有兩百個攤位。有一個保證提供免費零食，另一個則保證『改變人生的人脈』。

text.en: Join the snack club. Learn about competitive origami.
text.zh: 加入零食社。順便學會競技摺紙。

text.en: Join the networking club. Get a lanyard and a nervous handshake.
text.zh: 加入人脈社。拿到一條掛繩和一個緊張的握手。

text.en: A study-abroad program offers six months in a beautiful city. You speak the language at 'polite hello' level. The flights cost a small fortune.
text.zh: 交換學生計劃提供半年在美麗城市的生活。你的當地語言只有『禮貌打招呼』的程度。機票貴得像一筆小財富。

text.en: Go. Order food by pointing.
text.zh: 出發。靠比手畫腳點餐。

text.en: Stay home. Watch travel videos with subtitles.
text.zh: 留在家。看附字幕的旅遊影片。

text.en: Your food budget is $40 a week. Your stomach has filed a formal complaint.
text.zh: 你每週的伙食預算是 40 美金。你的胃已經提出正式申訴。

text.en: Meal-prep rice and beans for seven days. Become a spreadsheet.
text.zh: 一週七天都吃備餐米飯和豆子。人生變成一張試算表。

text.en: Order takeout twice. Live a little.
text.zh: 叫兩次外送。偶爾也要活一下。

text.en: You've been 'talking' to someone for three months. Nobody has said 'together'. Your friends run a group chat about it.
text.zh: 你跟某人『聊』了三個月，沒有人說過『在一起』這三個字。你的朋友們還為此開了群組。

text.en: Ask directly. Brace for impact.
text.zh: 直接問清楚。做好承受衝擊的準備。

text.en: Keep it vague and let the group chat speculate.
text.zh: 保持曖昧，讓群組自行推測。

text.en: The dorm fire alarm goes off at 3 a.m. because someone burned popcorn. Again.
text.zh: 宿舍防火警報在凌晨三點響起，原因又是有人燒焦了爆米花。

text.en: Evacuate in pajamas and become a campus meme.
text.zh: 穿著睡衣疏散，順便成為校園迷因。

text.en: Volunteer as dorm safety rep. Get a stipend and a whistle.
text.zh: 自願當宿舍安全代表。領到津貼和一支哨子。

text.en: A campus job opens: night shift at the library desk. Duties include shushing people and guarding the good chairs.
text.zh: 校園打工缺人：圖書館夜班櫃檯。工作內容是叫人小聲點，以及守護好位子。

text.en: Take it. Become a legend of the quiet.
text.zh: 接下。成為安靜界的傳奇。

text.en: Decline. Sell your class notes online instead.
text.zh: 婉拒。改把上課筆記放到網路上賣。

text.en: Your unpaid internship's main task: making coffee for twelve people, none of whom know your name.
text.zh: 你的無薪實習主要工作：幫十二個人泡咖啡，其中沒有人知道你的名字。

text.en: Stay. Learn every coffee order and every secret.
text.zh: 留下。記住每個人的咖啡口味和每一個祕密。

setJob.zh: 實習生（無薪，咖啡因超標）

text.en: Quit and freelance designing logos for friends.
text.zh: 辭職，改幫朋友接案設計標誌。

text.en: You discover your credit score is 'not enough data'. The bank suggests you 'build history'.
text.zh: 你發現自己的信用評分是『資料不足』。銀行建議你『累積紀錄』。

text.en: Open a starter card and pay it on time like a monk.
text.zh: 辦張入門信用卡，並像僧侶一樣準時還款。

text.en: Ignore it. Cash is king (and lonely).
text.zh: 不理它。現金為王（而且很孤單）。

text.en: Your thesis topic: 'The Sociology of Naps'. Your advisor sighs like a broken accordion.
text.zh: 你的論文題目：《午睡社會學》。指導教授嘆氣的聲音像一台壞掉的手風琴。

text.en: Commit. Nap-based fieldwork begins.
text.zh: 堅持到底。以午睡為主的田野調查正式開始。

text.en: Switch to a safe topic about supply chains.
text.zh: 改成一個安全的供應鏈題目。

text.en: You furnish your first apartment from the curb: a couch with a mysterious stain and a lamp with an attitude.
text.zh: 你的第一間公寓靠路邊撿來的家具布置：一張有神祕汙漬的沙發，和一盞很有個性的檯燈。

text.en: Take everything. Cover the stain with a blanket 'for style'.
text.zh: 全部搬回家。用毯子蓋住汙漬，美其名為『風格』。

text.en: Buy flat-pack furniture and lose two weekends to a diagram.
text.zh: 買組裝家具，兩個週末都輸給一張說明圖。

text.en: A weekend hackathon offers $500 for the best idea. Yours: an app that reminds you to drink water by insulting you.
text.zh: 週末黑客松提供 500 美金獎金給最佳點子。你的點子：一個用羞辱來提醒你喝水的 app。

text.en: Pitch it. Bring a mascot.
text.zh: 上台簡報。還帶了一個吉祥物。

text.en: Skip it and sleep for fourteen hours.
text.zh: 跳過，睡上十四個小時。

text.en: At the holiday table, a relative asks, 'So what's your plan?' Your plan is 'lunch'.
text.zh: 節日聚餐上，親戚問：『所以你的計劃是什麼？』你的計劃是『午餐』。

text.en: Say 'entrepreneur' and change the subject to pie.
text.zh: 回答『創業家』，然後把話題轉到派上。

text.en: Be honest: 'lunch, then figure it out.' Receive an hour of advice and some cash.
text.zh: 老實說：『先吃午餐，再慢慢想。』換來一小時的建議和一些零用錢。

text.en: You break up with someone you share a lease with. The houseplant is in both names.
text.zh: 你和同住的伴侶分手了。那盆室內植物是兩個人共同的名字。

text.en: Share custody of the plant. Send weekly growth updates.
text.zh: 共同監護那盆植物。每週傳送成長報告。

setRelationship.zh: 單身（與前任共同養植物）

text.en: Give them the plant. Keep the good pan.
text.zh: 把植物給對方，自己留下好用的平底鍋。

text.en: A student loan letter arrives with 'Congratulations!' in the header. It is not congratulations.
text.zh: 學貸通知信抵達，標題寫著『恭喜！』。這並不是恭喜。

text.en: Set up a payment plan and a spreadsheet named 'Doom'.
text.zh: 設定還款計劃，並建一份名為『末日』的試算表。

text.en: Deliver groceries on the side to pay it off faster.
text.zh: 兼差送生鮮雜貨，想更快還清。
